entities.summary: Juan Carlos Centeno is a Puerto Rican professional baseball catcher in the Arizona Diamondbacks organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, Milwaukee Brewers, Minnesota Twins, Houston Astros, Texas Rangers, and Boston Red Sox.
